decks.notes: In this Rakdos Aggro deck, the main focus is on aggressively disrupting the opponent's game plan using a combination of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Grief. The deck also includes efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Terminate to deal with threats on the board. The aggression is further enhanced by creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer, creating pressure on the opponent while also providing card advantage. Feign Death and Undying Malice are used to protect key creatures and maintain board presence, while Orcish Bowmasters provide additional removal options.

The deck focuses on utilizing Goryo's Vengeance to quickly bring out powerful creatures like Fallaji Archaeologist and Atraxa, Grand Unifier from the graveyard. Through the use of instant reanimation and support cards like Ephemerate and Faithful Mending, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combo-centric strategy. It also includes disruption spells like Fatal Push and Solitude to control the board while Leyline Binding and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional value and protection. The deck's key strength lies in its ability to execute explosive plays and outpace the opponent with unexpected combos.

The key strategy revolves around ramping up mana quickly with Amulet of Vigor and bouncing lands to generate multiple land drops per turn. This allows for explosive plays and combo potential with Primeval Titan fetching Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and other utility lands. Creatures like Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove help accelerate mana production, while cards like Tolaria West and Expedition Map provide additional utility. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with massive creatures and land-based synergies.

This deck utilizes a toolbox of creatures to create a combo engine, with Yawgmoth, Thran Physician as the central piece. By tutoring and sacrificing creatures with cards like Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, the deck can generate value and trigger powerful effects like Zulaport Cutthroat and Hapatra, Vizier of Poisons. The deck aims to create a loop of sacrificing and recurring creatures, while also disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Endurance and Grist, the Hunger Tide. With a mix of creature-based synergy and combo potential, this deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent with its versatile toolkit.

The main concept of this UR Control deck is to control the game through counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage provided by cards like Cryptic Command and Archmage's Charm. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating value from spells like Snapcaster Mage and Lórien Revealed. The inclusion of a few threats like Murktide Regent and Flame of Anor ensures that the deck has ways to close out the game once it has gained control. The mana base is designed to support the deck's spells with a mix of fetch lands and dual lands.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Amulet of Vigor to generate massive amounts of mana quickly, allowing for explosive plays with Primeval Titan. The main goal is to ramp into Primeval Titan as early as possible, using cards like Azusa, Lost but Seeking and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to play multiple lands per turn. The deck also utilizes Urza's Saga and The Mycosynth Gardens to generate additional creature tokens and pressure the opponent. By assembling the right pieces, the deck can quickly overwhelm the opponent with a powerful board presence and win the game.

The main idea of this deck focuses on control, utilizing powerful spells like Counterspell, Archmage's Charm, and Force of Negation to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Murktide Regent and Subtlety provide additional threats and versatility, while Fatal Push helps to deal with early threats. The presence of Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Sheoldred's Edict offer further control options. The key card in this deck is The One Ring, which can generate significant value and card advantage. Overall, the strategy revolves around controlling the game and out-valuing the opponent.

The primary focus of this deck is to assemble the Amulet Titan combo as quickly as possible to generate insane amounts of mana and put multiple threats on the board. The deck utilizes cards like Amulet of Vigor, Primeval Titan, and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to ramp up to its win condition, while also leveraging cards like Arboreal Grazer and Urza's Saga for additional value. By utilizing land synergies and powerful combo pieces, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and quickly close out the game.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on using aggressive creatures like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Murktide Regent to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It also includes a suite of counterspells like Spell Snare, Spell Pierce, and Counterspell to protect its creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also utilizes efficient burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat to remove threats and finish off the opponent. It makes use of card selection and manipulation through Preordain, Mishra's Bauble, and Expressive Iteration to consistently find the right cards needed for each situation.

This deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures that can be searched for and put into play at instant speed using Chord of Calling. The deck utilizes a combination of creatures that generate value when sacrificing or entering the battlefield, alongside powerful payoff cards such as Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide. By tutoring up the right creatures for the situation and leveraging sacrifice and token synergies, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a versatile and resilient board presence.

The main strategy of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, supported by efficient removal spells such as Unholy Heat and Lightning Bolt. The deck also includes a strong suite of counterspells like Spell Pierce and Counterspell to protect its threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Expressive Iteration provides card advantage and helps smooth out draws, while Dragon's Rage Channeler enables card selection and graveyard filling. The mana base is optimized with fetch lands and shock lands to ensure consistent access to both colors of mana.

The main concept of this UR Aggro Modern deck is to utilize cheap, efficient spells and aggressive creatures to quickly deal damage to the opponent and control the board. By combining powerful threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Murktide Regent, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer with versatile spells like Lightning Bolt, Counterspell, and Unholy Heat, the deck aims to maintain pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes card draw and deck manipulation tools like Preordain, Expressive Iteration, and Mishra's Bauble to ensure consistency and maximize tempo advantage.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures like Murktide Regent and Dragon's Rage Channeler while efficiently disrupting opponents with counterspells and removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. The deck also utilizes cards like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble to generate card advantage and dig for key pieces. By combining tempo plays with powerful threats, the deck aims to pressure opponents and control the game, ultimately overwhelming them with a mix of creatures and disruption.

This deck focuses on casting cheap cascade spells like Violent Outburst to cheat out powerful creatures and spells for free. By utilizing the Cascade mechanic, the deck can quickly overwhelm opponents with cards like Shardless Agent and Crashing Footfalls. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Force of Negation and Brazen Borrower to control the game. The goal is to quickly deploy threats and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize. The mana base is constructed to support the diverse casting costs of the cards in the deck.

This deck focuses on maintaining control of the game by using a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler. The key strategy is to consistently disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up your own win condition, whether it be by controlling the board with Supreme Verdict or overwhelming the opponent with card advantage from The One Ring. The deck also utilizes efficient removal options like Prismatic Ending and Solitude to deal with threats efficiently. Additionally, the inclusion of Kaheera as a companion provides additional utility and synergy with the deck's creatures.

The main focus of this Amulet Titan deck is to quickly ramp up mana and land drops using cards like Amulet of Vigor, Azusa, and Arboreal Grazer, while also utilizing Primeval Titan to search for powerful lands like Vesuva and Valakut. The deck can generate immense value by using the bounce lands like Simic Growth Chamber to untap lands multiple times in a turn. Additionally, by utilizing lands like Urza's Saga and The Mycosynth Gardens, the deck can create powerful tokens and threats to overwhelm the opponent.
